raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Let the DSpark draft inherit FP8 KV cache when GLM-5.3-Flash automatically selects FP8, instead of falling back to BF16.

With TP=4 and a full 2,048-token draft window, at 48 such requests, that is 960 MiB less draft KV data per GPU (3.75 GiB across four GPUs).

## Test

```bash
alias glm_serve_dspark="c 4 -- vllm serve $MODEL    --trust-remote-code     -tp 4     --load-format fastsafetensors     --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88     --enable-prefix-caching     --host 0.0.0.0     --port 9256     --max-model-len auto     --max-num-seqs 48     --kv-cache-dtype fp8     --speculative-config '{\"method\":\"dspark\",\"model\":\"$DRAFT_MODEL\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":8}'"
alias lm_eval="lm_eval run --model local-chat-completions --model_args base_url=http://127.0.0.1:9256/v1/chat/completions,model=$MODEL,num_concurrent=1024,seed=256 --tasks aime25 --trust_remote_code --apply_chat_template"
alias bench="vllm bench serve --model $MODEL  --dataset-name random --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256 --random-input-len 2 --random-output-len 1024 --max-concurrency 1 --num-prompts 32 --num-warmups 4 --trust-remote-code --temperature 0  --ignore-eos  --seed 256" 
```

files.patch:
@@ -166,7 +166,7 @@ def verify_and_update_config(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> None:
         spec_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
         if (
             spec_config is not None
-            and spec_config.method != "mtp"
+            and spec_config.method not in ("mtp", "dspark")
             and spec_config.kv_cache_dtype is None
         ):
             spec_config.kv_cache_dtype = "auto"
